comment: Versions of the shared runtime the cctui host injects at /plugin-runtime/*. Svelte and
@dorsk/tsumikit are external in the plugin bundle, so equality with the host — not semver
compatibility — is the requirement, and scripts/check-host-deps.sh enforces it against this
file. Bump both here and in package.json when the host upgrades. Once
@dorsk/cctui-plugin-sdk is published, read its peer ranges instead of pinning them here.
Shaped like a package.json so the check reads host and plugin the same way.
